artworks.title: Napoleon I and Captain Elphinstone (Napoleon I et le Capitaine Elphinstone)
artworks.description: The etching depicts a battlefield scene with mounted and standing figures in a historical military context. The central figure on horseback is dressed in a military uniform with a distinct hat. Another person is partially reclining on the ground, surrounded by soldiers in uniforms with tall plumed hats. The soldiers are equipped with muskets seen in the background. The figures are set against a backdrop of smoke-filled skies, suggesting active combat or its aftermath. The scenery includes grass and indications of a battlefield, with fallen figures and galloping horses in the distance.

artworks.title: Explosion of a Grenade (L'Explosion d'une grenade)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor scene depicting military activity and a burning fire. The drawing shows soldiers on horseback and on foot gathered around an area where a skirmish is taking place. Figures can be seen lying on the ground, suggesting the aftermath of a conflict. A fire emits smoke into the scene, adding to the drama. The background includes cloudy skies and distant architectural structures nestled among trees. The work features intricate hatching and cross-hatching techniques typical of such a historical representation.

artworks.title: Death of a Russian General (Le Mort d'un general russe)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battlefield scene. The image depicts a historical battle with soldiers in uniform scattered across the scene. In the foreground, several figures attend to an individual who appears injured or fallen. The soldiers wear detailed uniforms, complete with plumed hats, surrounded by fallen comrades. In the background, a cavalry horse stands amidst smoke and commotion, suggesting a dynamic conflict. Sketched lines hint at a distant row of troops engaged in combat, with smoke rising into the sky. The composition conveys the confusion and intensity of war through its many layered elements and expressive line work.

artworks.title: Capture of a Village (Prise d'un village)
artworks.description: This is an artwork depicting a battle scene in a village with a church steeple in the background. The image shows a chaotic battlefield with horsemen engaged in action amidst smoke and gunfire. In the center, riders are energetically portrayed, capturing a cavalry charge. The background features rustic buildings partially obscured by smoke. A leafless tree stands in the scene, contributing to the atmosphere. The intricate line work emphasizes the dynamic movement and dramatic tension of the composition.

artworks.title: Charge of the Cavalry (Charge de cavalerie contre des chasseurs)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene. The drawing shows a chaotic battlefield with a line of soldiers engaged in combat, smoke billowing as cannons and muskets fire. In the background, structures such as a windmill and assorted buildings are visible. The landscape is filled with rough terrain, grass, and small vegetation. The lines are detailed, capturing the movements of the soldiers and the frenzied atmosphere of a battle.

artworks.title: Cossacks before a Fireplace (Les cosaques devant la cheminée de la ferme en Hollande) [recto]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in the interior setting around a fire. The scene shows a group of uniformed figures standing and sitting around a blazing fire at the center. One figure is sitting on the ground, holding an object assumed to be a helmet with a sword nearby. Other figures are standing around, some holding rifles, while one is tending to the fire with a chain or rod. The room is characterized by heavy shadows and a rough wooden texture, with details like stairs visible in the background. The use of chiaroscuro creates a dramatic effect, emphasizing the flames and figures in the dimly lit room.

artworks.title: Title Page for A.D. van Buren Schele's  "Adolf van Gelder", Amsterdam, 1842
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a scene with knights and a castle under the moonlight. The artwork shows armored knights in conversation next to a horse, with a grand castle in the background. The castle has multiple roofs and turrets, set against a cloudy sky illuminated by the moon. In the distance, there are figures involved in an activity or conflict. The scene is detailed with shading to create depth and contrast, emphasizing the nighttime setting. Surrounding the composition is text that seems to be the title and publication information for a book or manuscript.

artworks.title: Cavalry and Hay Wagon
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a busy scene along a road. Soldiers on horseback are near us, alongside a small dog. A horse-drawn cart filled with goods is to the left. Two tall trees stand to the right, with other trees forming a canopy. Rolling hills are visible in the distance, blending into the sky. The artwork features fine cross-hatched brushstrokes creating texture. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of sepia to highlight the detailed linework and interplay of light and shadow.

artworks.title: Fisherman's Hut
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a log cabin on stilts on the left side. Near the cabin, there is a river with two figures next to a boat. Trees with dense foliage are spread across the scene, and in the distance, a church spire rises from a village. The horizon is low, with the sky occupying most of the top part of the image. The brushstrokes are detailed and fine, with cross-hatching creating texture and shadow. The color palette is monochrome, mainly using sepia tones for depth and detail.

artworks.title: Landscape with Millstone near a Cask
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural landscape with trees, a fence, rocky terrain, bushes, a cottage, figures next to the cottage, and a figure tending to animals. The scene is rendered in detailed line work with cross-hatching, using a monochromatic sepia color palette.

artworks.title: Three Cottages
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with two figures walking towards the right. Trees block the horizon, and there is a building to the left. Some wooden structures are seen in the foreground. The trees are detailed with fine line work, and the overall color palette is monochrome, with shades of black and white. The technique appears to be careful engraving, with precise lines throughout the scene.

artworks.title: Woman in a Riverscape Looking towards a Boat
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic scenery with a wooden cabin on the right side, a water body or stream with rocks and figures in it, and a background of tall pine trees. The view is from a slightly elevated position looking downward, capturing the detailed texture and monochromatic color palette emphasizing contrast.

artworks.title: John Milton
artworks.description: This is a portrait of a man in a seated position. He has long, wavy hair, a sharp-featured face with a solemn expression, forward-facing eyes, slightly drooping eyelids, a prominent nose, and firm-set lips. The man is dressed in 17th-century attire, including a large white collar over a dark garment. The background features an oval frame with a plaque beneath the portrait inscribed with the name "Ioannis Miltoni Effigies" and the date 1670. The style of the image suggests it is an engraved print.

artworks.title: Albrecht Altdorfer
artworks.description: This is an engraved portrait showing the upper body of a man depicted from the chest up. The man is in a slightly turned position, facing forward with a calm expression. He has distinct facial features, including prominent eyes and a long, pointed beard. The hair on his head is short, covered partially by a cap. His clothing includes a high-collared garment with a fur trim. There are no noticeable pieces of jewelry or objects being held by him. The background features a lined pattern, encased within an oval frame, with the initials 'A.D.' placed to the right of the man's head. The name "ALBRECHT ALTDORFER" is written below the portrait.

artworks.title: An Old Woman at the Toilet Table
artworks.artist: Jeremias Falck after Johann Liss after Bernardo Strozzi
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows three figures in upper-body view. In the center, an older woman sits holding a flower and looking into a mirror. Standing behind her, another person adjusts her elaborate hair adornments. To the side, a young man assists in holding the mirror. A third figure, standing to the right, smiles while looking at the scene. Various objects are on the table in front of them. The background is an indoor setting with a textured wall and shadows emphasizing the figures.

artworks.title: Le Galand Jardinier (The Gallant Gardener)
artworks.artist: Jacques de Favanne after Antoine Watteau
artworks.description: The image shows a man and a woman standing outdoors. The woman is seated, wearing a light-colored dress and a hat. The man is crouching, holding a spade. Behind them is a tree with gardening tools and a wheelbarrow filled with produce. The background includes more trees, shrubs, and a small structure among foliage. A bird is flying overhead. The image is framed with faint lines and has text at the bottom.

artworks.title: Adult and Two Children
artworks.medium: graphite and pen and gray ink
artworks.description: The image is a faint pencil drawing showing three individuals in the center of the frame. The adult figure is depicted at a slightly higher position, bending slightly forward, and seems to be holding both children by their hands. The artist has focused on the basic outlines, and the facial features and hair of the figures are minimally detailed. The clothing appears to be simple, with long robes suggested for each figure. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held in the image. The background is plain and unadorned. The paper shows slight aging but remains largely unmarked apart from the delicate linework of the drawing.

artworks.title: Antique Battle Scene (?)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of abstract, loosely sketched forms that suggest energetic, dynamic human figures engaged in movement or dance. The drawing is composed of lightly penciled lines on a plain, off-white background, indicating a raw and unfinished sketch. The lines create an interplay of shapes that hint at a collection of figures, some with raised arms, suggesting a scene of action or interaction among the forms. The sketch captures a sense of flow and motion while remaining abstract and open to interpretation.

artworks.title: Antique Bearded Head
artworks.medium: brush and gray ink with gray wash
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical sculpture's head. The drawing features the head of a bearded figure rendered in grayscale, conveying three-dimensional depth through shading and highlights. The hair and beard are intricately detailed with curling strands. The face carries a serene and noble expression with prominent brow ridges and a straight nose. The eyes are hollow, characteristic of sculptural representations, enhancing the classical aesthetic of the piece. The attention to detail and smooth transitions in shading suggest it might be a study of an ancient statue.

artworks.title: Antique Head with a Helmet
artworks.medium: brush and gray ink with gray wash
artworks.description: The image depicts a close-up of a statue's head showcasing its facial features and helmet. The frontal view reveals symmetrical features including straight eyebrows, a nose, full lips, and a prominent chin. The hair is styled in wavy locks and the statue wears an ornate helmet with intricate detailing. The background is a plain, light-colored surface.

artworks.title: Bust of a Bearded Man Looking Up
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of a man's head and upper shoulders. The man is facing left with his face slightly angled upward. He has a prominent nose, well-defined beard, and long flowing hair with waves falling around the shoulders. The sketch emphasizes detail on the head and hair, with minimal lines suggesting clothing. The background is plain with crosshatch shading, and there are no visible jewelry or objects in the image.

artworks.title: Classical Portrait Bust of a Bearded Man
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of a bust in side profile. The subject is facing left with detailed facial features, including a prominent nose and full beard. The person is depicted wearing classical attire and a fitted cap or hat. The background is plain, emphasizing the detailed drawing.

artworks.title: Donkey Stretching a Hind Leg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a donkey with a saddle. The image shows a pencil sketch of a donkey in profile with a saddle on its back. The lines are lightly drawn to show the donkey's shape, ears, body, and tail. Minimal detailing and basic shading are used to suggest form and volume. The drawing appears to be a simple and unfinished study or quick sketch.

artworks.title: Figure Being Transported through the Air
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of abstract figures in motion. The drawing features a chaotic scene rendered in pencil on paper, with entangled figures representing elements of movement and tension. The right side shows a complex cluster of elongated forms, possibly suggesting arms or figures in dynamic movement, while the left side might depict a supporting figure. The composition is sketchy and fluid, characterized by quick, expressive lines and shading that create a sense of turbulence and struggle. The overall style suggests a sense of urgency and spontaneity, indicative of preliminary sketches or conceptual explorations.
